emma: ran into an onboarding footgun: types in the quickstart behave in node but become `unknown` after bundling for the edge. Looks like generics + overloads + our exports map.

hiro: can you paste the tiny repro? this sounds like the generic inference collapse we've seen before.

emma: minimal: `export function fetch<T>(opts: Opts): Promise<T>; export function fetch(opts){ return client.call(opts) }` then `const x = await fetch<{id:string}>({path:'/me'})`  node: x.id ok; edge bundle: x: unknown.

cal: what bundler and tsconfig? bundlers sometimes flatten d.ts and lose overload info.

emma: vite -> rollup for edge. tsconfig uses `moduleResolution: "bundler"`, package exports use conditional export with both cjs+esm and a single `types` pointer.

nora: pattern: when the bundler rewrites type-only imports it can create local aliases and the compiler loses the specific generic constraint, widening to `unknown` or `any`.

hiro: another vector: our retry/auth wrappers are overloaded (callback vs promise). Overloads + generics cause contextual types to disappear in the edge build, so callers get `unknown` and add `as any` which hides the bug.

emma: repro included in the PR: `function withRetry<T>(fn: ()=>Promise<T>): Promise<T>; function withRetry(fn){ return retry(fn) }` call site `await withRetry(()=> sdk.getUser<{id:string}>(id))` -> node: fine. edge: result is `unknown`.

cal: short-term sample fixes: 1) pin sample tsconfig to `moduleResolution: node` so emitted d.ts are stable; 2) point package `types` explicitly at ESM d.ts for edge; 3) in samples prefer single-generic signatures for wrappers (avoid overloads).

nora: long-term SDK changes: 1) consolidate the declaration shape (avoid mixing `export =` fallback with ESM exports), 2) consider providing a small `types/edge.d.ts` entry so bundlers have a canonical path, 3) audit wrapper helpers (auth/retry) to use discriminated unions or single generic signatures.

hiro: also add CI for sample that runs the real bundler + `tsc` so we catch dts rewrites early.

pkg-bot: CI: node-cjs typecheck OK. edge-bundle typecheck failed on master at 2823456700. Branch `devex/edge-typing-stability` shows green.

emma: added a tiny lint rule for samples banning `as any` / `// @ts-ignore` and a README blurb: "Edge bundlers & TS: prefer explicit ESM types, pin resolution, avoid overloads in wrappers". PR is open.

cal: thanks. let's follow up with an SDK issue to track the typing consolidation. This will reduce onboarding friction.

emma: PR link posted in the issue. TL;DR: generics+overloads+conditional types + bundler rewrite => inference widening in edge builds; mitigations and CI added.
